settings.title: Loyalty that keeps customers coming back
settings.description: Explain points, tiers, referrals, and member benefits in a dedicated loyalty landing page that feels rewarding and easy to understand.
settings.bullets:
Points on purchases
Tier unlocks and perks
Referral rewards and early access
settings.cards: Simple education | Help customers understand exactly how the program works. ||Strong retention | Encourage repeat purchases and deeper engagement. ||Useful for email and CRM | Pair with loyalty app flows and campaigns.
settings.secondary_description: A clear loyalty message makes customers feel recognized and gives them a reason to return again and again.
